description.zh: 写不清楚的问题，模型只能用篇幅填。点一下输入框左侧的星芒，把你那句话补成「能答」的样子。
description.en: A vague question gets answered with length. Click the star left of the composer to make your sentence answerable.

description.zh: 痛点：一句话提问往往没有说清「什么算答对了」，模型无法反问，只好用篇幅填满不确定性。这个插件在你点星芒时，用当前会话的最近几轮做背景，把你那句话补成对方能答的提问——只写回输入框，不会替你发送。
description.en: Most prompts fail because they never say what counts as a good answer. This plugin rewrites the sentence you were about to send, using the last few turns as context, into something answerable. It writes back to the composer and never sends for you.
